title: 美债新买家是谁？30年期收益率创23年新高
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: The US Treasury has just sold 25 billion dollars of 30-year bonds at a yield of 5.216 percent.
segments.zh: 美国财政部刚刚发行了250亿美元30年期国债，收益率为5.216%。

segments.en: That's the highest rate the government's paid on 30-year debt since 2001.
segments.zh: 这是自2001年以来政府为30年期债务支付的最高利率。

segments.en: That effectively means the interest rate which the US taxpayer pays to bondholders is sold massively in the last few years.
segments.zh: 这实际上意味着美国纳税人向债券持有人支付的利率在过去几年大幅上升。

segments.en: The reason everyone should care is because government bond yields determined the value of equities, corporate debts and even mortgages.
segments.zh: 每个人都应关注的原因是，政府债券收益率决定了权益资产、企业债务甚至抵押贷款的价值。

segments.en: Let's be clear, America can still sell its debt. The vital question is who's buying it and what it now costs to keep them at the table.
segments.zh: 明确地说，美国仍能出售其债务。关键问题是，谁在购买，以及让他们留在谈判桌上的成本现在是多少。

segments.en: The US national debt passed 40 trillion dollars this year. That's an issue for Treasury Secretary Scott Becant, because it means it needs to issue more and more bonds to refinance maturing debt.
segments.zh: 美国国家债务今年突破了40万亿美元。这对财政部长斯科特·贝森特来说是个问题，因为这意味着需要发行越来越多的债券来为到期债务再融资。

segments.en: Older bonds mature constantly. That puts the Treasury back in front of investors month after month.
segments.zh: 旧债券不断到期，这使得财政部月复一月地回到市场参与者面前。

segments.en: Whatever the prevailing rate happens to be. For most of the last two decades, that dependence cost very little.
segments.zh: 无论现行利率如何，在过去二十年的大部分时间里，这种依赖的成本非常低。

segments.en: Interest rates in the US and globally were depressed.
segments.zh: 美国和全球的利率都处于低位。

segments.en: As inflation has searched back after the pandemic, we've seen government borrowing cost the world over, rise.
segments.zh: 随着疫情后通胀回升，我们看到全球政府的借贷成本都在上升。

segments.en: Bond prices and yields move in opposite directions. As investors sold their bonds, the government's cost of borrowing climbed.
segments.zh: 债券价格与收益率走势相反。当市场参与者抛售债券时，政府的借贷成本随之上升。

segments.en: More recently, that expense climbed furthest at the long end of the market, where lenders are committing cash for 30 years.
segments.zh: 近期，长期限市场的成本攀升最为明显，贷款人将资金锁定30年。
